m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: I thought I told you to never show your face around here again! What do you want?
Sorry. Did you convince Vazivika to stop abusing the merchants? You did! And you recovered all the stolen goods? GREAT JOB!
Oops... I mean, great job. I knew I was right to trust you with this, despite what they say about your Fifth Column leanings.
Truly, your honor knows no bounds. Might I call upon that honor one last time?
Mind your tongue when you speak to me, you worthless scum!
Sorry, but I can't risk any nosey antennae catching me asking for your  help. Just stand there and... and  look cowed. That's perfect.
Vazivika the SpiritBreaker is supposed to interrogate the merchants to root out information on Fifth Column activity.
But what she is doing is threatening to report the merchants, guilty or not, unless they give her bribes.
I'd be branded a traitor if I reported my commanding officer. That's why I need you to stop her. And discreetly.
Vazivika's house is just over there. Confront her inside. Just don't mention my name!
Wait for Vazivika the SpiritBreaker in her house, and convince her to stop forcing the merchants to give her bribes.
